query: 碳定价 碳定价 衡量企业将碳成本纳入经营与投资决策的成熟度及透明度。 重点考察： 1）是否对内部碳定价机制进行明确说明（包括肯定或否定声明）； 2）是否探索或建立了碳成本评估机制； 3）碳定价在资本支出或项目评估中的应用深度。 内容质量得分： 2分 (领先)： 正式应用与披露。 企业已建立明确的内部碳定价机制（如影子价格、碳费），披露了具体的定价水平及计算方法，并有实际案例证明该价格已应用于重大投资决策或项目筛选。 1分 (起步/正面回应)： 透明声明与制度探索。 企业在报告中对碳定价议题有正面回应。包括： 明确声明目前尚未建立该机制（透明度体现），即否定声明； 或处于“内部模拟”和“制度探索”阶段； 或仅在原则性描述中提到将碳成本纳入考虑，但尚未形成标准价格。 0分 (缺失)： 完全未披露。 报告中对“碳定价”或“碳成本评估”完全没有提及，未展现出对该议题的任何关注。 内部碳定价 内部碳价 内部影子价格 内部碳费 投资决策碳成本 资本开支碳价筛选 尚未建立内部碳定价 ICP internal carbon price internal carbon pricing shadow carbon price internal carbon fee carbon cost in investment decisions carbon price in capital expenditure no internal carbon price ICP 企业是否披露已建立内部碳定价机制，或明确声明尚未建立？ 是否披露影子价格、碳费或内部碳价水平及计算方法？ 碳价是否用于资本支出、项目筛选或投资评估？ 若尚未正式应用，是否处于内部模拟或制度探索阶段？ 是否有实际应用案例？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '碳定价'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否披露已建立内部碳定价机制，或明确声明尚未建立？ 是否披露影子价格、碳费或内部碳价水平及计算方法？ 碳价是否用于资本支出、项目筛选或投资评估？ 若尚未正式应用，是否处于内部模拟或制度探索阶段？ 是否有实际应用案例？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅讨论外部碳市场行情而无内部定价；仅有转型风险定性描述；仅有减排目标；仅提及碳税宏观政策而无企业机制；区分：碳定价关注企业内部是否建立并应用碳成本定价机制，含否定声明；转型风险可提及碳价作为外部政策风险，但不等于已建立内部碳定价；场景分析中的碳价假设不等于企业已实施内部碳定价。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

During the year, the Group's total GHG emissions were 301.1 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO 2 e), with an emission intensity of 0.08 tCO 2 e per square meter of floor area. [Section]
Resources Consumption / 2021 Energy Consumption (MWh)

[Content]
Greenhouse gas ('GHG') emissions from our business operations include direct emissions from fuel consumption (Scope 1), indirect emissions from the use of electricity (Scope 2) and other indirect emissions from business travel by air, paper disposal at landfills, freshwater processing and sewage treatment (Scope 3). During the year, the Group's total GHG emissions were 301.1 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO 2 e), with an emission intensity of 0.08 tCO 2 e per square meter of floor area. The GHG emissions were mainly contributed by emissions from the use of electricity, which constituted around 62% of total GHG emissions.

results.text: The Group continues to follow a green office policy and has taken a range of measures for conserving energy, water and paper consumed in its operations to ensure efficient management and use of resources. Moreover, we reduce the use of carbon dependent energy sources and other natural resources by deploying more energy-efficient processes and green technologies. Guidelines on energy, water and paper-saving are provided to all employees. Through encouragement and education, we strive to drive behavioural changes for conserving energy and natural resources within the workplace.

A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

results.text: Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
BOARD STATEMENT

[Content]
Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.

results.text: In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE / Supply Chain Management

[Content]
In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

results.text: To inspire employees to acquire new knowledge and keep abreast of the latest trends in the logistics industry, we encourage employees to participate in external training programmes based on their job needs and promote a comprehensive learning environment in the workplace. The Performance Appraisal System helps department managers to identify and confirm employees who need training. We select suitable staff to participate in job-related external courses, seminars and workshops, according to their positions and needs. During the year, we arranged both internal and external training sessions for our employees with various themes including dangerous goods, cargo operation, warehouse in/out procedures and regulated agent regime.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Training and Development

[Content]
To inspire employees to acquire new knowledge and keep abreast of the latest trends in the logistics industry, we encourage employees to participate in external training programmes based on their job needs and promote a comprehensive learning environment in the workplace. The Performance Appraisal System helps department managers to identify and confirm employees who need training. We select suitable staff to participate in job-related external courses, seminars and workshops, according to their positions and needs. During the year, we arranged both internal and external training sessions for our employees with various themes including dangerous goods, cargo operation, warehouse in/out procedures and regulated agent regime.
